items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She wanted to sing with the band. So she asked me about putting in a word... At the first concert, she did some stuff.

ctx.x: He was your student. He was – we were in the graduate – masters program together.

I don’t know if he’s playing so much, Harry, because I saw Harry. I don’t know whether it was Memphis or Nashville or somewhere like that. He’s a motivational speaker now. But he was an incredible pianist, and I’m sure he still does play occasionally, but I don’t think – not like he used to. There was Regina Belle – I don’t know if you remember her – who was – had a bunch of hit records, pop, pop singer. She had a bunch of – a string of hit records. She – I remember her being in piano class, taking piano lessons…
Yeah, now that you mention it. Yeah. I forgot about Jeanie.
